purpose: Teach: フロリダ/クリントン/信長/ヘンリー/ハンター/つくば/赤坂/ミクロ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、フロリダのテーマパーク憧れてたな
lines.en: Remember how you were obsessed with that Florida theme park?
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the opening. Knowing grin in the voice. Pace stays light and easy. She's calling him out in the best way.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でクリントン政権習ったろ?桜
lines.en: Wait, didn't you study the Clinton administration in history class?
lines.style: Quick rebuttal, caught-you energy. Slight laugh underneath. Pace snappy but not hostile. He's enjoying the back-and-forth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で織田信長習ったろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't you learn about Oda Nobunaga in history?
lines.style: Mirror his rhythm but softer. Knowing smile. Gentle tease. She's matching his move, turning it back on him with affection underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ヘンリー王子のニュースチェックしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were totally following all those Prince Henry updates, weren't you?
lines.style: Caught-you directness. Warm with it. Rapid-fire, no escape route. Eyes bright. He's enjoying the ambush.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ハンター×ハンター読んでたな
lines.en: Don't think I didn't see you devouring Hunter Hunter.
lines.style: Wry, sideways delivery. Deadpan surface but warmth beneath. Slow enough to land. The kind of observation that says 'I notice you.'

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、つくばの研究機関見学行ったろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't you go on that research facility tour in Tsukuba?
lines.style: Lighter, almost sing-song. Quick setup. The trap is closing in and they both know it. Small grin in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、赤坂のスタジオライブ行ったろ
lines.en: You went to that studio live concert in Akasaka, right?
lines.style: Pushing a little harder now. More confident. She can feel him running out of ammunition. Pace picks up slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、理科でミクロの世界習ったろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't you study the microscopic world in science class?
lines.style: The final move, delivered with close warmth. Intimate rhythm like they're in on something together. Quiet triumph. No room left to dodge.
